newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary Aug industry output down 9.1 pct m/m.
newsitem.headline: Hungary Aug industry output down 9.1 pct m/m.

text.p: Hungary's industrial output fell by a seasonally-adjusted 9.1 percent in August from July and dropped 3.2 percent from August 1995, the Central Statistical Office (KSH) said on Monday.
The accumulated industrial output for the January-August period rose 1.4 percent this year from the same period of last year, it said.
HUNGARY INDUSTRY OUTPUT Aug 1996 July 1996 Aug 1995

NOTE - Industrial sales in August fell 4.1 percent from August last year. Domestic sales fell 7.1 percent, while export sales rose 3.7 percent. Out of total industrial sales exports accounted for 30 percent, up from 29 percent in August 1995.
